title: First-touch Observability Canvas and Lens Assets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a curated set of onboarding/quickstart visual assets that showcase observability dashboards for new users. Focused deliverables: a hero screenshot (latency summary + SLO badge), a cost-per-token cards set (per-route breakdown and hover states), and an annotated trace view (span grouping, service waterfall, and suggestion callouts). Assets should be production-ready: annotated PNGs for docs, layered Figma files for future edits, and a responsive mock for the quickstart modal (mobile/desktop).
acceptance_criteria: Hero latency dashboard screenshot with annotated SLO status and one-line tooltip copy
Cost-per-token cards: overall, per-model, and per-route screenshots including hover/state overlays
Annotated trace view: clear span labels, error highlights, and a short caption describing how to interpret durations
All assets exported in 2x PNG and SVG where applicable, filenames follow naming convention, and assets uploaded to the shared Drive folder
Figma file contains named frames, componentized cards, and a short notes page with copy for docs team
design_links: Figma frames: Heatmap, LatencyHero, CostCards, TraceLens
review_comments: 2026-02-26 @Jonas Kim (PM): Love the hero composition; please reduce info density on the hero to one KPI + SLO. Add an alternate with simplified legend.
2026-02-28 @Sanjay Mehta (Eng): Make sure trace screenshot avoids any live customer IDs; use synthetic traces. Also request a 1200px wide export for the docs header.
2026-03-01 @Marta Lopez (Design Lead): Approve direction. Request small text-size increase on card labels for accessibility. Upload updated Figma and ping docs once exported.
2026-03-02 @Marco Ruiz (Assignee): Uploaded updated frames to Figma and added an 'alt-text' notes page. Preparing export batch.
steps: Audit current observability dashboards and capture baseline screenshots (eng to provide sandbox dashboards)
Create Figma canvas with separate frames: hero-latency, cost-cards, trace-annotated, mobile modal
Iterate with PM/Eng on content density and sanitize data for screenshots
Generate exports (PNG 2x, SVG where possible) and place in Drive folder with naming convention
Add a short caption and suggested alt text for each asset for docs team
Hand off to Docs with usage notes and link to Figma components
decisions: Use synthetic traces instead of production data to avoid PII and customer identifiers
Prioritize a single hero KPI (p50 latency) accompanied by SLO badge to keep onboarding page scannable
Use a condensed card layout for cost-per-token to fit doc header without scrolling
Include a second ‘expanded’ trace view for the console tour, but keep quickstart trace as an annotated single-span summary
notes: Accessibility checklist included on Figma notes page: contrast, font-size >= 14px for body labels, descriptive alt text
Recommended exports for docs: 1200px width for hero, 800px for cost card grid, 1100px for trace expanded
Docs team contact: @Jonas Kim (PM) — add captions: one-sentence interpretation + optional CTA to console
